body.name: Theorem-specific generic loci
body.construction: \(\mathcal M^{\circ}_{s,p,q}(G,G')=\{\theta\in\mathcal M_{p,q}(G):\prod_{f\in\mathcal Q_s(p,G,G')}f(\theta)\ne0\}\) for \(s\in\{\mathrm{term},\mathrm{branch},\mathrm{fork},\mathrm{width}\}\), equipped with the relative Zariski topology inherited from the semialgebraic ambient domain. The factor \(\prod_{k\in V}(t_k-v_k)\) belongs only to the covariance families, so terminal compatibility is not restricted by variance activity.
